check:integration.difference_reason: Native never deletes declared outputs before a case (frozen _prepare_outputs unlinks stale files); it preserves user files and requires CLOCK_REALTIME_COARSE freshness against the pre-start inventory, so a stale file is a measured output assertion failure (cpp_contracts/native_validation_extra fixtures). {python:current} means the component's declared project interpreter, never ici's own runtime (frozen used sys.executable). Cases are executed independently and an incomplete case leaves the check incomplete instead of aborting later cases; invalid configuration is refused at plan time as a blocked check instead of a run-time Integration:ConfigurationError target. Shadow build outputs are addressed by BUILD/PATH or the frozen VARIANT:shadow:PATH (and >512-char path-<sha256>) identity of a prepared native variant; a bare shadow-relative path is not guessed. Open: frozen `ici next verify` emits one finding per failed aspect (integration.exit / integration.stdout / integration.stderr / integration.output, process_fingerprint over absolute argv) while native modern runs emit the single case-level ici.hybrid.process-contract finding (finding_site adapters/providers/integration.py:143:12); the shared ici-config argv bound counts UTF-8 bytes (1024 per token, 32768 total) where frozen _integration.py counts code points, so long non-ASCII tokens are refused earlier.
